name: Dr. Vishnu K. S.
bio: Dr. Vishnu K. S. is a dedicated Ayurvedic physician committed to preserving the rich healing traditions of our hospital while providing compassionate, patient-centred care. Specializing in Balachikitsa (Kaumarabhritya), the branch of Ayurveda devoted to the health and well-being of infants, children, and adolescents, he focuses on promoting healthy growth, strengthening immunity, supporting developmental milestones, and managing childhood health concerns through safe, evidence-informed Ayurvedic practices.

With a deep respect for classical Ayurvedic principles and a commitment to individualized treatment, Dr. Vishnu believes that every child deserves a healthy beginning. His approach emphasizes preventive care, holistic healing, and close collaboration with families to ensure the best possible outcomes for every young patient.

As a founder, he is dedicated to carrying forward our hospital's 150-year legacy of authentic Ayurvedic healing, combining timeless wisdom with compassionate clinical care to serve future generations.

name: Dr. Shilpa Vishnu
bio: Dr. Shilpa Vishnu is a psychologist with expertise in promoting emotional well-being across different stages of life. She is passionate about integrating psychological care with holistic health, recognizing that true healing involves both the mind and the body.

Her areas of focus include maternal mental health, postnatal emotional well-being, women's mental health, parenting support, child psychological well-being, stress management, anxiety, emotional resilience, and psychological counselling. She believes that compassionate listening, scientific understanding, and individualized care are essential to supporting lasting mental wellness.

As a co-founder, Dr. Shilpa works to strengthen the hospital's vision of providing comprehensive care by combining the wisdom of Ayurveda with modern psychological approaches. Together with the clinical team, she strives to create a nurturing environment where mothers, children, women, and families receive holistic support for both physical and emotional health.
